Notable during rollout, all found and fixed: a nested ConfigMap mount that would have stopped Prometheus starting; four alert rules that could never fire (label mismatch, count-of-empty, an opt-in metric never enabled, and add_metric_suffixes renaming metrics out from under the rules); an Alertmanager inhibit rule matching a label no alert carries, which made one NodeNotReady mute every alert cluster-wide; Grafana basic auth left enabled behind a hidden login form; a sync-wave deadlock between WaitForFirstConsumer PVCs and their consumers; the data disk mounted at /mnt/framlux while the StorageClass pointed at /mnt/data on the root LV; a gateway running collect-exactly-once receivers at 2 replicas, causing a 42% export failure rate; and a doubled k8s_namespace_name label hiding all CNPG metrics.
